high_level_description: The image shows a person standing outdoors in front of a building with a wooden door. The individual is wearing a red strapless dress that has a ruched design and a decorative red flower on the side. The dress is paired with black high-heeled shoes and white socks. The person is also wearing a red baseball cap with the word "MERRY" written on it in white letters. They have long, dark hair and are accessorized with a gold bracelet on their left wrist. The setting appears to be a residential or commercial area, as indicated by the modern building with vertical siding and a concrete walkway.
